A WORKING BEGINNING

The calendar comes first.

SHOWS starts with Portland's underground metal, punk, goth, rock, hardcore, and DIY scenes. Markets, creative learning, and community events broaden that discovery. SHOWS is a provisional name. Inclusion is not endorsement; original organizers get the credit.

No sign-in, analytics, behavioral tracking, or user profiles. Saved events are stored only in this browser. Calendar and map links open external services only when you choose them.

Event times are shown in Portland's Pacific Time zone. Published details can change. Sources checked October 17, 2026. Recurring entries include only the dates in this snapshot.
